title: The Ripple from a Single Drop
youtube_title: The Ripple from a Single Drop | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A small beautiful thing can be shared with the eyes only.
summary: At a harbor wall at low tide, Femi finds a ripple from one drop off the roof. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Femi shows Noemi how to look without disturbing it. the ferryman looks too, and they leave it where it is.
